{{Top|leg}}
'''Heji tal''' was a [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] technique incorporated into [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in his establishment of the [[New Jedi Order]]. Sinking into this meditation and surrendering completely to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], it could establish inner peace, grant knowledge, and bring about serenity. Using the skills of [[Force power/Legends#Control|control]], [[Force power/Legends#Sense|sense]], and [[Force power/Legends#Alter|alter]], in different combinations, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could achieve this state of restful clarity.
